mapper.select: SELECT ordno, ordstate, rgdate, rgr, upddate, updpn, autoapvean AS autoapvean, jijumcd AS jijumcd, coid AS coid, ntnid AS ntnid, memo, ordnore AS ordnore FROM pppo1000t
